related_questions.question: Is remdesivir still approved for COVID?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, remdesivir (brand name Veklury) is still approved and available for treating COVID-19. It is approved for use in both hospitalized and non-hospitalized patients who are at high risk for severe COVID-19. The medication is administered intravenously and should be started as soon as possible after symptom onset, ideally within seven days.
